notes: ZeusToken (src/ZeusToken.sol) is a plain fixed-supply EIP-20 token: name Pegzeus, symbol ZEUS, 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 ZEUS (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which on this launch is the factory. totalSupply() is a compile-time constant: there is no mint, no burn, no owner, no minter, no pause, no blocklist, no freeze, no burnFrom, no seize, no upgrade path and no fallback or receive function, so after deployment the contract has no privileged caller and the supply can neither grow nor shrink. Transfers move exactly the amount requested with no fee, tax, reflection or burn, so the factory's transfer to the MerkleDistributor, the distributor's claims, the Uniswap v4 seed and every swap arrive whole; because nothing is taxed, the token needs no exemptions and does not take $factory, $poolManager or $launchNumber. Transfers to the zero address and approvals of the zero-address spender revert with ZeroAddress(); an allowance of type(uint256).max is unlimited and not decremented. The contract imports no library and calls no other contract; its runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. There are no application contracts and no initialization calls. Pool and economics are the launch's own: the pool pairs with IMD at fee 12500 and tick spacing 60, initialPrice is provenance only, and the deployer derives the opening price from initialMarketCapWei (2,500 IMD for the whole supply) and totalSupply. Built with solc 0.8.26, optimizer 200 runs, cancun, bytecode_hash none, cbor_metadata false.
